1.text: "Nimushimire Uwiteka yuko ari mwiza, 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; Yer 33.11 Kuko imbabazi ze zihoraho iteka ryose.

2.text: "Nimushime Imana nyamana, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

3.text: "Nimushime Umwami w'abami, Kuko imbabazi ze zihoraho iteka ryose.

4.text: "Nimushime Ikora ibitangaza yonyine, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

5.text: "Nimushime iyaremesheje ijuru ubwenge, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

6.text: "Nimushime iyasanzuye isi hejuru y'amazi, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

7.text: "Nimushime iyaremye ibiva bikomeye, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

8.text: "Yaremye izuba gutwara ku manywa, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

9.text: "Yaremye ukwezi n'inyenyeri gutwara nijoro, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

10.text: "Nimushime iyakubitiye Abanyegiputa abana b'imfura babo ikabica, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

11.text: "Igakura Abisirayeli hagati yabo, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

12.text: "Ibakujeyo intoki z'imbaraga n'ukuboko kurambutse, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

13.text: "Nimushime iyatandukanije Inyanja Itukura, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

14.text: "Igacisha Abisirayeli hagati yayo, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

15.text: "Ariko igakunkumurira Farawo n'ingabo ze mu Nyanja Itukura, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

16.text: "Nimushime iyashorereye ubwoko bwayo mu butayu, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

17.text: "Nimushime iyakubise abami bakomeye, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

18.text: "Ikica abami b'amapfura, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

19.text: "Yica Sihoni umwami w'Abamori, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

20.text: "Yica na Ogi umwami w'i Bashani, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

21.text: "Itanga ibihugu byabo ngo bibe umwandu, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

22.text: "Umwandu w'Abisirayeli abagaragu bayo, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

23.text: "Yaratwibutse ubwo twari ducishijwe bugufi, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

24.text: "Idukiza abanzi bacu, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

25.text: "Igaburira ibifite imibiri byose, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.

26.text: "Nimushime Imana yo mu ijuru, Kuko imbabazi zayo zihoraho iteka ryose.
